title: Slalom gates · Level 3: Random gates
brief: Five gates placed at random for each run: x spaced 350-500 mm from x = 600 mm, y between 350 and 850 mm. Before the run the course writes them to gates.json on the flash as [[x, y], ...] (json.load(open("gates.json"))); practice runs without it, so upload seed 0's: [[600, 486], [997, 392], [1373, 840], [1783, 567], [2277, 843]]. Then cross the finish line at x = 2700 mm. 15 points a gate passed cleanly (the robot's centre between its posts, the gates in order), 25 x min(1, par / t) when all five are passed and the finish crossed, 5 off for each post touched (each post once), never below 0; a run that skips a gate scores 0. t runs from Run to the centre crossing the finish line, which ends the run; 60 s a run. Par: 8 s.

score.run: if(visited > visitedInOrder, 0, round(max(0, 15 * min(5, visitedInOrder) + if(visitedInOrder == 6, 25 * min(1, par / max(visitTime_6, 0.001)), 0) - 5 * (min(1, touchesOf_postL_1) + min(1, touchesOf_postR_1) + min(1, touchesOf_postL_2) + min(1, touchesOf_postR_2) + min(1, touchesOf_postL_3) + min(1, touchesOf_postR_3) + min(1, touchesOf_postL_4) + min(1, touchesOf_postR_4) + min(1, touchesOf_postL_5) + min(1, touchesOf_postR_5))), 1))
